knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: Fixed 3 incorrect theorem statements (conway_angle_identity/B/C). RHS was t.α₃ but should be π/3 + t.α₃. Build now clean on Lean 4.26.0. 0 sorries, 0 axioms.
insights: The morleys_theorem_axiom was mathematically incorrect as stated: MorleyTriangle was an unconstrained structure (arbitrary 3 points)
Proof strategy: sine rule in trisector sub-triangles + cosine rule + triple sine identity + symmetry of 8R sin(a/3)sin(b/3)sin(c/3)
Key identity proved: cosine_rule_identity — sin²p+sin²q-2sin(p)sin(q)cos(c)=sin²c when p+q+c=π
Core lemma: morley_arm_cosine_rule factors out k² from cosine rule and applies the identity
All three Morley sides equal (8R sin α₃ sin β₃ sin γ₃)² by cyclic symmetry of the formula
conway_angle_identity theorems had incorrect RHS: π - earApex_B - earApex_C + π/3 = 2π/3 - β₃ - γ₃ = π/3 + α₃ (not α₃). Fixed all three variants.
